publication_scope: Historical execution benchmark and implementation numerical equivalence only; not an independent pose-accuracy result. No checkpoint or image dataset is included.

performance.scope: RAM RGB -> resize/normalize -> all H2D transfers -> real model -> 17 values D2H -> C++ FK/distortion projection/Chinese arrows and XYZ panels -> completed RGB canvas. No disk/image decoding, capture latency, video encoding, imshow or refresh.
performance.telemetry_scope: GPU telemetry includes warmup and measurement; CPU percentage is measured-loop process CPU time / wall time.

accuracy.scope: Numerical difference from the configured baseline (see baseline_engine/execution), not error against ground truth. Separate independent recurrent state per sequence.

cases.purpose: Repeated existing RGB tests runtime state, not extra accuracy samples
